parsed.why: Court injunctions block bathroom, marker and care bans, so no local facility ban is in force. But enacted 2026 sex-definition law, religious-refusal statute and no state hate-crime GI leave it only modestly above the hostile national baseline.

Veto-override bathroom-bounty law reaches airports and public buildings, with criminal/civil penalties and ID invalidation; Do Not Travel. State-level universal exposure sits far below the already restrictive national baseline.

Most Protective: statutory gender-identity nondiscrimination, hate-crime coverage, self-ID markers, shield law; no local facility or custody exposure documented. National passport, entry and facility regime still caps it.

Low-risk tier: codified nondiscrimination, explicit hate-crime coverage, panic-defence and conversion-therapy bans; no local facility restriction. Unrepealed dead-letter sodomy law and unconfirmed X marker are minor; national regime caps.

Most Protective with shield law and broad care coverage, but documented birth-sex prison placement used as punishment and pending anti-trans ballot measures; custody exposure offsets its strong care protections under the national regime.
